description:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

About the role

As a Talent Operations Specialist on our Global Talent Team, you’ll be the engine behind how we hire, combining sharp coordination, smart systems and a strategic mindset to help us hire smarter, faster and better.

This role blends exceptional interview coordination with talent strategy support and ownership of our TA operations. You'll use automation and AI to free up recruiter capacity, keep our hiring systems and vendors running smoothly, and raise the bar on the experience we give candidates and hiring leaders. This role reports to our Senior Director of Global GTM Recruiting, and supports a global team across the US, EMEA & APJ.

About Global Talent at Dataiku

We're not just filling roles. We're building the strongest possible teams, aligned to real business needs and backed by a world-class approach to talent. Our Global Talent exists to act as partners to the business and make talent a strategic lever rather than a reactive function.

  • Join a forward-looking Global Talent function at a company shaping the future of AI.
  • Work in a global, collaborative environment that values curiosity, precision and impact.
  • Play a hands-on role across the talent lifecycle, from how talent is identified and evaluated to how it's hired and supported.

What you'll do

Interview scheduling and candidate experience

  • Own end-to-end interview scheduling across regions and time zones, streamlining scheduling and pipeline tasks with automation tools and AI agents.
  • Deliver a best-in-class candidate experience from first outreach to offer.
  • Be the trusted logistics partner for recruiters and hiring managers.
  • Identify and implement low-lift, high-impact process improvements.

Talent strategy

  • Support talent mapping and the building of proactive talent pools.
  • Help prepare calibration sessions and post-hire reviews.
  • Put Dataiku's competency framework into practice across hiring and talent workflows.
  • Track patterns, surface insights and continuously refine how we assess and onboard talent.

TA operations and systems

  • Act as the main point of contact for our TA vendors, including Greenhouse, GoodTime, BrightHire and LinkedIn, managing CSM relationships, business reviews and renewals.
  • Administer our TA tech stack, including user provisioning, templates and system settings, and resolve Greenhouse to Workday hire sync issues so onboarding and payroll stay on track.
  • Keep our hiring processes compliant, including candidate data deletion and anonymization, and partner with Legal on offer template updates.
  • Partner with People Systems to test and scale new AI scheduling and feedback tools, and to make sure upcoming system changes land on time.
  • Lead the monthly TA Ops Essentials session, sharing new tool features and process updates with the TA team.
  • Manage TA procurement, including vendor and agency intake through Coupa and Ironclad, and agency purchase orders.
  • Own TA communication channels, including support tickets, Glassdoor review responses and our monthly Hot Jobs post.

What you'll need to be successful

  • 2 to 4 years of experience in recruiting coordination, recruiting operations or a fast-paced People function.
  • Hands-on experience with Greenhouse or a similar ATS, and familiarity with tools such as GoodTime, BrightHire, Gem or AI agents.
  • Experience administering recruiting systems and integrations (for example, Greenhouse and Workday) and managing vendor relationships.
  • A solid understanding of candidate data privacy and hiring compliance.
  • You're highly organized and calm under pressure, and you enjoy working through complexity and ambiguity.
  • You're comfortable working across cultures, time zones and competing priorities.
  • You're excited by automation and AI, and eager to apply them in your day-to-day work.
  • You communicate clearly and confidently with candidates, recruiters and executives alike.
  • You're curious, detail-oriented and mission-driven.

Nice to have

  • Exposure to competency-based hiring or performance frameworks.

#LI-CM

 
What are you waiting for!
At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! And if you’d like to learn even more about working here, you can visit our Dataiku LinkedIn page.
 
Our practices are rooted in the idea that everyone should be treated with dignity, decency and fairness. Dataiku also believes that a diverse identity is a source of strength and allows us to optimize across the many dimensions that are needed for our success. Therefore, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All employment practices are based on business needs, without regard to race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. This applies to all policies and procedures related to recruitment and hiring, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion and termination and all other conditions and terms of employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact us at: reasonable-accommodations@dataiku.com
 
 
Protect yourself from fraudulent recruitment activity
Dataiku will never ask you for payment of any type during the interview or hiring process. Other than our video-conference application, Zoom, we will also never ask you to make purchases or download third-party applications during the process. If you experience something out of the ordinary or suspect fraudulent activity, please review our page on identifying and reporting fraudulent activity here.
